acceptedInterpretation: Fill the utils-build gap at the root npm test path via a pretest that builds both packages (main then utils), plus an un-gameable regression guard; explicitly NOT by editing the worktree handler or bootstrap-runner (those are out of scope).
notes: Single coherent interpretation; the only ambiguity (which layer to fix) was resolved by investigation showing validate never needs utils and done_required runs npm test, so pretest is the correct point.
